name: 52057 · Manchester, IA
findings: ZIP 52057 (Manchester) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 52057 (Manchester) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 52057 (Manchester) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).
